rationale: The previous frame was refused for rendered lettering, so this reading moves the story off paper and into the physical event the count is about: the countable appliance water loss. A cinematic still lets one decisive domestic moment — the burst hose, the opened wall, the drying fan, the blank claim folder — say 'a water claim is on file' without a single legible word. Blue-hour dusk with one warm worklight gives the scene the hushed tension of a policy quietly climbing toward nonrenewal.
subject: a burst washing-machine supply hose and the water-stained wall opened for repair behind it, with drying gear and a closed claim folder
core_thesis: A homeowners policy is repriced on how many claims are counted, not dollars paid — so the appliance water loss inside the house is the claim that can end the policy, while the storm on the roof never counts at all.
core_conflict: The interior water claim a carrier can count against the house versus the weather loss it cannot — with the homeowner's renewal hanging on which category the damage falls into.
composition: asymmetric 16:9 — washer and opened wall commanding the right third, air mover low left, generous negative space above
